$schema: Objects of note — folklore items and story relics. Surfaced when referenced by creatures or story beats. 'realm' tags whether it belongs to the garden or the Táin.

artifacts.name: The Sealskin
artifacts.plain: A selkie's sealskin is her whole self folded small. Worn, it returns her to the sea; lost or hidden, it strands her on land. Many tales hinge on a husband who locks the skin away.

artifacts.name: The Cohuleen Druith
artifacts.plain: The red feathered cap of the Merrow. With it she dives the deep; without it she is bound to walk the shore. To take one is to take the sea-maiden's freedom.

artifacts.name: The Cold Ember
artifacts.plain: The lantern-light a will-o'-the-wisp is said to carry — a coal that gives no warmth, taken from a fire that belongs to neither this world nor the next.

artifacts.name: The Royal Treasures of Cruachan
artifacts.plain: The cups, rings, brooches, fine cloth, flocks and herds that Medb and Ailill lay out to be counted. Matched piece for piece — proof that wealth alone could not settle their rivalry.

artifacts.name: Donn Cúailnge, the Brown Bull
artifacts.plain: Not merely livestock but a being of power and temper — the one prize in Ireland worth a war. To the people of Cooley he is a guardian; to Medb, an obsession.
